name: known-gap-role-shape-conflicts
reason: ScorePreferenceFit routes role_shape preferences at culture_signals and core_competencies. Two consequences on this JD, and neither #53's widening nor migration 021's rename closed them. (1) The 'frontend' negative is typed role_shape. The role shape lives in required_skills (React, TypeScript, CSS) and in screening_summary.other_flags ('frontend-majority role, roughly 80% of time in the client codebase'), and the role_shape branch reads neither. This fixture also predates core_competencies and carries none, which is where a competency-worded extraction would have put it. This is Group C of notes/hard-exclude-preference-audit.md, which called 'pure frontend' miscategorized for the same reason. (2) 'on-call heavy' and 'mandatory overtime' are the persona's words; the JD's words are '24/7 on-call rotation' and 'extended hours'. containsPhrase requires a contiguous whole-word run, so neither matches -- the same morphological miss documented for REST vs RESTful APIs in matchesAny, and the same one that keeps the adtech gate silent.
description: The three conflicts database/sample/README.md says this fixture surfaces. Asserted separately from weak-match.json so that the gaps-vs-conflicts separation stays enforced while the matching defect stays visible.
